message: No detected input validation: The /predict route reads form fields and applies arithmetic transformations but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards before using the data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local CSV file and local pickle/JSON files with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution comparisons, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tools (e.g., Cleanlab) are present anywhere in the data preparation code.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The code performs only basic normalization and encoding of features with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.
No detected model integrity verification: Models and artifacts are loaded via pickle.load() from file paths with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revisions before deserialization.
No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, validates expected label sets, or detects anomalous training samples before or during training.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: No backdoor or trigger detection mechanisms such as neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection are present anywhere in the code.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses standard scikit-learn estimators with no differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) applied.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing libraries (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD) or stress tests are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or multiple independent metrics being enforced; evaluation metrics are computed without any tampering protection mechanisms.

No detected input sanitization: The /predict route reads form values and applies only numeric casting/scaling without any shape, range, or schema validation; malformed or out-of-range inputs are not rejected.
No detected output bounds checks: The prediction output is simply rounded and formatted into a string with no NaN guards, negative-price checks, or sanity bounds applied before returning to the user.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This pipeline uses classical ML regressors/classifiers (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
